H: During a held client-facing sync completion after a real X roundtrip, prior single-key chord leaves the key down; repaired chord has already queued/processed UP and has one effect. Both retain possible-DOWN custody until completion returns and finish neutral.

stop: Stop on first execution/cleanup error; otherwise collect all four scientific outcomes then audit. No rerun of an arm or whole attempt.
authority: User-selected PC; native WSL2/private authenticated Xvfb; no WSLc allocation or Docker/Windows desktop input
C: Injected completion hold occurs AFTER actual sync reply. It is not network reply loss or blocked send, no prior delayed server request. Fixed ABBA reduces simple drift but not all confounding; two samples/method only.
U: No hard deadline, arbitrary exactly-once effects, production speedup, MAP01, provider/model efficiency or broad reliability. No model calls.
